work_item: B04 ordinary CLI JSON structural and CSV/JSON keyed-table comparison, symmetric reserved-marker correction and explicit difference projection
subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine
purpose: Supplied structured documents -> sealed input -> unique Core -> exact differences with two-sided original locations and typed stops -> caller-declared downstream projection
three_document_set: N/A; no construction three-document set specified
source_snapshot_method: SHA-256 of compact JSON file inventory in code-snapshot.json
initial_state: The three operations were wired to Core but their initial comparison validation records were build-only. Complete English header parsers and ASCII case admission already agreed; no parser grammar/version change was needed.

baseline_defect.method: Four fresh CLI stores, one side/marker combination each, and separate inspect matching original request and complete result.
baseline_defect.observed: A literal --- MINIDORA LEFT CSV --- inside a left-side cell incorrectly reached COMMIT/COMPUTED with a schema-valid difference report. The other three combinations suspended with CSV_COMPARE_DELIMITER and no dependency.
baseline_defect.cause: csv_compare_by omitted LEFT marker text in the left payload from its reserved-text checks. LF-suffixed delimiter-count checks do not reject the bare marker lexeme embedded in a cell.
baseline_defect.contract: README and initial CSV comparison audit reserve both marker texts in both payloads. This is a contract-admission defect, not malformed report serialization.

correction: Add the missing left-payload LEFT-marker contains guard. New executions reject all four side/marker combinations with CSV_COMPARE_DELIMITER. Valid report shapes, exact comparison rules, mappings and parser revision are preserved.

tests_and_route.route_method: Real minidora-rust --json processes, actor/case-authorized dependency reads and separate inspect processes verify original requests and complete results. Actual report text is supplied to a new explicit object-projection request.
tests_and_route.post_review: Add an explicit decoded header-value assertion to the equal/empty CSV branch. Rerun the affected CSV test (9 fresh stores/9 requests) and workspace fmt/check/clippy; all pass. Other four tests and product source are unchanged from the five-test run.
tests_and_route.full_workspace_tests: NOT_RUN; scoped comparison routes, marker admission and workspace all-target compile/lint were exercised. No full-workspace current-snapshot runtime claim.

cases: Equal objects: key order, escaped key/string, 1/1.0, -0/0, integer beyond 2^53 and equivalent exponent lexemes
Nine ordered differences: empty key, escaped a/b~c array order/length, absent/null, adjacent huge integers, string/number and composed/decomposed Unicode
Root scalar versus array with pointer empty string
route_observations.evidence: Exact raw side hashes, equality flag/comparison type and complete independently expected ordered differences with optional original ranges/hashes. Empty key pointer is / and a/b~c component is a~1b~0c. Numbers compare as bounded exact decimals.

cases: Changed table with reordered right rows
Equal decoded tables with reordered rows and escaped header/key/string spellings
route_observations.evidence: All four change objects, values, optional fields/Pointers, raw changed-cell or whole added/removed-row ranges/hashes, side hashes and equality flag match explicit expected values. No maps for all unchanged cells or output offsets are claimed.

cases: Two changed cells for key 2, removed multiline/empty row gone, added row new and reordered matching right rows
Equal reordered tables with quoted/unquoted equivalent header/key/cell forms
route_observations.evidence: Exact report and count/order/string parameters. Changed report has 19 spans = 1 header + 2 changed cells x 5 + 2 added/removed rows x 4. Complete span objects match independent side/row/column/raw/decoded/output locations, duplicate token occurrences, null matched-key output offsets and zero-width unquoted empty cell. Equal/empty outputs retain one exact header map.

route_observations.route: Actual reports -> explicit differences or changes root-field projection
route_observations.evidence: Each of the three actual report texts is consumed by a new json-object-project request. Projected array equals its actual report field; exact source/output hashes and selected raw field/output maps are checked. Caller-fed explicit composition, not an inferred Core plan or strict-table adaptation.
SUSPEND/UNKNOWN, no result dependency, exact original request and complete stopped result through separate inspect. Decoded duplicate table keys are tested on each side.

versioned_recomputation.initial_driver_error: Omitting --input allocated new input-8/version 1. The corrected binary properly returned SUSPEND/exit 2; the diagnostic driver incorrectly required exit 0 and stopped before saving stdout. Its durable result was recovered with fresh inspect, not reconstructed stdout. This was not an exact retry.

versioned_recomputation_evidence: versioned-recompute/observations.json plus exact retry/version-2/full-inspection files. The original accepted marker result remains historical; exact retry does not correct it retroactively. A new input version recomputes under the corrected validator and stops.
render_and_persistence_evidence: Positives check COMMIT/COMPUTED, RENDERED, actual text hash, content-plan equality, one authorized dependency, original body/request and complete persisted result. A non-equal comparison report is a valid COMPUTED result.
oracle_scope: Fixed unique side/row/member fragments and raw lexemes supply independent positions. CSV repeated output tokens use explicit occurrence numbers. These authored cases are scoped QC, not a held-out acceptance population.
evidence_writer_note: The first fixture-extraction attempt assumed same-line constant values and stopped on a formatted multiline CSV constant before creating this audit. Existing snapshot and manifest remained valid. Extraction now accepts formatting whitespace; no runtime/source correction was needed.

retained_local_evidence.remote_storage_verification: NOT_RUN; local state/log retention only, no OneDrive storage claim

known_limits: B04 and the 93-requirement population are not closed by authored comparison fixtures.
Non-first key columns, one-sided empty tables, broader schemas/transformations, boundary-size/difference/output-cap populations and independent evaluation are not covered here.
Structural equality is not factual truth or general semantic equivalence. CSV reports use kind plus artifact counters; JSON uses change/equal and source metadata.
Full workspace runtime regression, external LIVE evaluation, Windows/macOS, physical 8 GB QA, release and deployment are NOT_RUN.

acceptance.B04: UNVERIFIED; selected normal comparison/typed-stop routes and one contract correction observed, not complete B04 acceptance
